tasks.prompt: Add public int DaysOverdue(Invoice invoice) to InvoiceService: the number of whole days the invoice has been overdue, computed in UTC from the injected clock, and 0 when the invoice is not overdue. Add unit tests.
A new team member asks why SqlHelper still exists and what they should use instead. Answer in at most five sentences. Do not modify files.
tasks.reference: SqlHelper is a 2016 helper that is kept only because MonthlyRevenueReport, its last caller, has not been migrated yet; BILL-97 owns that migration. It is marked [Obsolete], and ConventionTests fail the build if code outside Legacy/ calls it. For new data access, follow ADR 0007: a Dapper repository behind an interface, like IInvoiceRepository / InvoiceRepository, with parameterized SQL and a CancellationToken on every async method.
counterexamples: SqlHelper is the standard data access layer. Use SqlHelper.ExecuteDataSet for new queries because it is simple and well tested.
